run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only run under the environment's unchanged global outbound-egress block (re-verified this run: WebFetch to www.tenders.gov.au and www.tenders.vic.gov.au both failed with DNS ENOTFOUND; the agent-proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true with zero recent relay failures - a deliberate network-policy denial, not a transient fault). Consequently NO live tender detail page or specification document could be opened on ANY portal, so all 25 recorded opportunities are headline-level only (all counted in entries_pending_detail) with no deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/documents/contacts extraction. WebSearch (routed via Anthropic infrastructure, not the egress proxy) was the only working tool; it is US-indexed and lags the live Australian portals, so IDs and closing dates come from cached snippets and must be re-confirmed. Captured 25 open opportunities (10 newly-seen this run, 15 carried from prior runs and re-confirmed open). New this run: Victoria/Buying for Victoria (3: Ports Victoria Station Pier marine infrastructure maintenance T421508, DEECA property-portfolio cleaning T2026-0812, Mallee CMA hydrological investigations RFT00000031), NSW/buy.nsw (1: Service NSW Small Business Advisory Services SNSW/9635), WA/Tenders WA (2: Water Corporation Engineering Design Services Panel 7000015483, Dept of Communities Perth Aboriginal Short Stay Accommodation DOC202226457), local government (4: Mildura RCC Meridian Road reconstruction 2027/333 via VendorPanel, Bundaberg RCC Supply of Bedding Sand TEN/3093 via VendorPanel, Brisbane City Council landscaping RFP and road-construction RFP via the council's own current-tenders channel). Carried/re-confirmed open: VIC Victoria Police eyewear T5956; NSW Homes NSW Granville (LAHC 2026/534) and Grafton (LAHC 2026/510), Blacktown cleaning C41/2026, Local Land Services statewide pest-animal panel P_2621542; QLD Bundaberg TEN/3109 and TEN/3131; WA Police WAPOL13726 and two PTA works (PROPTA26020, PTA260048); NT/QTOL five (T26-1265, T26-1274, NTG26-0202, T26-1314, NT Police/Fire vessel-packages panel). Tier 3 (mandatory) was checked: SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery exposed no publicly-visible Australian RFx (registration-gated); the major retail/energy buyers (Woolworths, Coles, AGL, Origin) and EstimateOne construction packages (one Marsden Park Anglican College scaffolding package, close 30 Oct, login-gated) exposed no publicly-readable open RFx - corporate portals are retained in the known source set and NO corporate opportunities were fabricated. Source discovery: four genuinely new buyer-originated sources recorded (Mildura Rural City Council, Capital Health Network/ACT PHN, Horizon Power/WA GBE, Toward Home Alliance/SA NFP), plus a note on the 2026 Commonwealth contractor-panel reform.
gaps: EGRESS POLICY BLOCK (global, unchanged): the environment network policy denies all outbound HTTPS to external hosts. WebFetch to www.tenders.gov.au/atm and www.tenders.vic.gov.au both failed with DNS ENOTFOUND; the proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true with zero recent relay failures, confirming a policy denial, not a transient error. Not retried per proxy guidance.

No tender detail page, specification document or portal listing page could be opened on ANY source, so all 25 recorded opportunities are headline-level only - deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, contacts and exact value/contract terms could not be extracted from primary sources. Every opportunity is flagged UNVERIFIED-AT-DETAIL; IDs and closing dates come from WebSearch cached snippets and should be re-confirmed on the live portal when connectivity is restored.

Commonwealth AusTender (tenders.gov.au): no currently-open Commonwealth approach-to-market closing in the target window could be confirmed this run - WebSearch returned only general guidance, reform notices and older/closed ATMs, and the live portal is unreachable under the egress block. Commonwealth Tier 1 effectively deferred this run.

Tenders SA (tenders.sa.gov.au): the live portal is unreachable and searches collided with South African tender sites and aggregators; no open South Australian STATE government tender could be confirmed against the buyer portal. SA state Tier 1 deferred.

Tenders Tasmania (tenders.tas.gov.au) and Tenders ACT (tenders.act.gov.au): only closed/awarded items or aggregator pages surfaced; no open state/territory tender with a confirmable November-December 2026 close could be captured against the buyer portal. An aggregator-listed City of Launceston 'Blue Cafe and Deck Renewal' (~13 Nov 2026) could not be confirmed and was NOT captured. TAS and ACT state/territory Tier 1 deferred.

Queensland state (QTenders / supply.qld.gov.au): WebSearch surfaced mostly aggregators and closed listings (e.g. VP5xxxxx references); no open QTenders STATE tender with a confirmable Nov-Dec 2026 close could be captured against the buyer portal. Only Brisbane City Council's own current-tenders channel yielded capturable (reference-less) local-government items. QLD state Tier 1 deferred.

GBEs / government-owned corporations (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, Transgrid, Ausgrid, Australia Post, NBN Co, SA Water, etc.) were searched but returned only closed, awarded or stale listings via aggregators; only Water Corporation (WA) Engineering Design Services Panel (via Tenders WA) and an unconfirmed Horizon Power PPA EOI could be associated with a buyer portal. The rest deferred to future runs when live-portal access is available.

Universities, TAFEs and CSIRO: searched but returned only closed/stale aggregator listings (CQUniversity, Monash, Adelaide, QUT, UTS, ANU) with no confirmable open closing date against a buyer portal. Deferred.

Public health (HealthShare NSW, state Local Health Districts, Queensland Health): searched but only aggregator pages with ambiguous dates surfaced (e.g. a HealthShare NSW pharmaceuticals RFT ~8 Nov 2026 and a WA anaesthetic-workstations panel ~6 Nov 2026 with no confirmable buyer-portal IDs); none captured to avoid fabricating detail. Deferred.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery exposed no publicly-visible open Australian RFx via search (registration-gated); major retail/energy/bank/telco buyers (Woolworths, Coles, AGL, Origin, CBA, Telstra et al.) exposed no publicly-readable open RFx; EstimateOne construction packages are login-gated (one Marsden Park Anglican College scaffolding package ~30 Oct 2026 seen at headline but not readable). Portals retained in the known source set only; invitation-only consultancy RFPs remain out of scope and were not fabricated.

Carried first_seen marker: the 15 carried opportunities are written with first_seen=2026-10-19 as a 'previously seen' placeholder; scripts/aggregate.js recomputes true first_seen from the earliest daily snapshot containing each dedup_key, so aggregate.json remains accurate.

Restore live-portal access (lift the outbound-egress block, or run an authenticated/unblocked pass) so detail pages and specification documents can be opened - without it every run is limited to headline-level, search-cached rows and cannot extract deliverables, requirements or evaluation criteria.
recommended_seed_additions: Mildura Rural City Council (VIC) - publishes civil/flood-recovery works via VendorPanel; a regional-Victorian local-government channel that returned a concrete, well-dated open tender this run (ref 2027/333). Worth adding as a weekly-checked source.

Capital Health Network (chnact.org.au/tenders) - the ACT Primary Health Network; publishes buyer-originated health/community-services tenders and EOIs. Completes PHN coverage alongside WAPHA and NT PHN.
Horizon Power (horizonpower.com.au) - WA's regional electricity GBE; procurement/EOI channel (e.g. long-term PPA EOI) distinct from the core Tenders WA portal. Monitor monthly.
Toward Home Alliance (towardhome.org.au) - SA homelessness alliance running buyer-originated EOIs for ACCO/ACCHO partners; an NFP/alliance channel worth monitoring monthly.

Commonwealth procurement reform (Dept of Finance): the AusTender Supplier Portal opened to all businesses from 1 July 2026 and a single whole-of-government professional-contractor panel replaced 20+ agency arrangements from 1 July 2026 - track for how open ATMs are now routed.
Restore live-portal / authenticated access so the routine can extract deliverables, requirements and evaluation criteria rather than headline-level search snippets.
